140019.en: It is said you are the mainstay of the sect, {call|B|A}. What a great honor it is to meet you here today!
140019.ch: 早就听闻{call|B|A}您乃我宗门支柱，今日一见，果然非同凡响！

141001.en: It is Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect! Allow this humble novice of the Junior Sect to pay my respects.
141001.ch: 原来是上宗的{call|B|A}，请受下宗晚辈一拜！

141002.en: Namaste, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect!
141002.ch: 原来是上宗的{call|B|A}，下宗晚辈有礼了。

141003.en: What an honor it is to catch a glimpse of {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect. This humble novice of Junior Sect is overjoyed!
141003.ch: 今日一睹上宗{call|B|A}您的风采，下宗晚辈真乃三生有幸！

141004.en: The destiny of {schoolName|A} rests on your broad shoulders, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect.
141004.ch: 我大{schoolName|A}未来命数，全要仰仗上宗{call|B|A}您之威势。

141005.en: {schoolName|A} basks in the glory of your presence,{call|B|A}. May you stand astride the world and never fall!
141005.ch: 我{schoolName|A}幸有{call|B|A}您坐镇，必能屹立八荒，万年不倒！

141006.en: {call|B|A}, you are a true talent and the envy of all novices of the Junior Sect.
141006.ch: {call|B|A}您真乃八荒才俊，羡煞我等一众下宗晚辈也。

141007.en: If this humble novice had half your talent, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, I could leap over the Dragon Gate and thumb my nose at the world!
141007.ch: 晚辈若得上宗{call|B|A}您半分天资，定能鱼跃龙门，傲视群雄！

141008.en: If you have time, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, would you mind showing us novices of the Junior Sect some of your moves?
141008.ch: 上宗{call|B|A}您若有闲暇，还望多多垂训我等下宗晚辈。

141009.en: If only you would teach me, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, this humble novice of the Junior Sect could die without regret.
141009.ch: 若有幸得上宗{call|B|A}您的教诲，下宗晚辈死而无憾矣。

141010.en: It's my lucky day today! My fortune said I would meet you, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect.
141010.ch: 下宗晚辈今日卜得大吉，原来是会与上宗{call|B|A}您相遇，实在妙极。

141011.en: It is my great fortune to meet you today, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect!
141011.ch: 得遇上宗{call|B|A}，下宗晚辈今日实在造化不浅！

141012.en: You are a mainstay of the sect, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect. This humble novice of the Junior Sect is a long time admirer.
141012.ch: 上宗{call|B|A}您德高望重，乃是宗门支柱，下宗晚辈早已仰慕多时。

141014.en: Now that you are here, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, glory awaits {schoolName|A}!
141014.ch: 有上宗{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}睥睨八荒，指日可待！

141015.en: Without you, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, I fear the glory of {schoolName|A} would not be what it is.
141015.ch: 若无上宗{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}怕是远无今日荣光。

141016.en: The best thing about being a {school|A} Novice is, I get to spend time with you, {call|B|A}.
141016.ch: 身为{school|A}晚辈，最值得骄傲之事便是与{call|B|A}您身处同宗。

141018.en: In your absence, {call|B|A}, {schoolName|A} would be lost, like a fish out of water.
141018.ch: 我{schoolName|A}若离了{call|B|A}您，便如同出水之鱼，难以长久。

141019.en: It is said you are the mainstay of the Senior Sect, {call|B|A}. What a great honor it is to meet you here today!
141019.ch: 早就听闻{call|B|A}您乃上宗的支柱，今日一见，果然非同凡响！

142001.en: How dare you! You want to slay your father?
142001.ch: 你这逆子还想如何？弑父吗？

142002.en: How dare you! You want to slay your mother?
142002.ch: 你这逆子还想如何？弑母吗？

142003.en: Even a tiger won't eat its child. How can you be so heartless to me?
142003.ch: 虎毒亦不食子，你为何能如此狠心对我。

142004.en: Whoever murders their family will meet their own end in the same way.
142004.ch: 残害手足之人，迟早会有报应的。

142005.en: Husband and wife? Ha, don't make me laugh.

142006.en: Get out of my sight, you bitch!

142007.en: Well, aren't you my husband who vowed to protect me all my life?
142007.ch: 哟，这不是口口声声说要护我一世的丈夫吗？

142008.en: But I'm your Partner! How can you be so cruel to me?
142008.ch: 可我是你的道侣啊，你为何还要如此狠毒。

142009.en: I never held anything back from you, and this is how you "repay" me?
142009.ch: 我向来对你倾囊相授，你的“回报”可真是让我出乎意料啊。

142010.en: So you taught me all those things only to destroy me one day? What a fool I was to be grateful to you.
142010.ch: 看来你往日对我的那些指导，不过是为了更好的毁掉我。哈哈哈，我居然还对你感激不尽。

142011.en: Where is my Taoist Mind... Where is my Taoist Mind...
142011.ch: 我的道心呢……我的道心呢……

142012.en: Now that I'm a good-for-nothing, why don't you just kill me?
142012.ch: 反正我如今也是个废人了，你不如将我直接杀掉算了。

142013.en: I was a Heaven-chosen with a promising future. Now it's all gone... all gone...
142013.ch: 想我堂堂一代天骄，本应前途无量。如今，全都没了……全都没了……

142014.en: Give back my Taoist Mind... Give it back to me...
142014.ch: 你还我道心……你快还给我……

142015.en: Just finish me. I don't want to live a humiliated life.
142015.ch: 给我一个了断吧，我不想再这么屈辱的活着了。

142016.en: If I hadn't messed with you, I would still live a safe and promising life.
142016.ch: 若是当初不招惹你，是不是我如今还能继续当我的天之骄子。

142017.en: Have you enjoyed yourself? Get out of my sight then!
142017.ch: 看完我的笑话了？那还不快滚！

142018.en: Ever since my Taoist Mind was destroyed, life and death have lost their meanings for me. If you keep messing with me, I vow to kill you even at the cost of my life!
142018.ch: 从我道心被毁那日起，我就已看淡生死。你若再叫嚣，可别怪我死前拉着你垫背！

142019.en: As they say, he who has nothing to lose has nothing to fear. I have nothing to lose, but what about you?
142019.ch: 俗话说得好，光脚的不怕穿鞋的。反正我已一无所有，就看阁下有没有勇气与我不死不休。

142020.en: Even though I have lost my Taoist Mind, you are still too weak to taunt me.
142020.ch: 就算我道心被毁，你想来嘲讽我，还不够格呢。

142021.en: How dare a {grade|A} wimp like you kick me when I'm down! You overestimate yourself!
142021.ch: 你一个{grade|A}的废物，还想对我落井下石。还是先掂量掂量自己有几斤几两吧！

142022.en: True I've lost my Taoist Mind, so what? I can bring you down with one finger. I wonder where you got the guts to taunt me.
142022.ch: 不过是少颗道心而已，我即便只用一根手指头都能赢你。实在不知你何来的胆子，对我大放厥词。

142023.en: {call|A|B}, you don't need to worry about me. I'll rise and become a Heaven-chosen again one day.
142023.ch: {call|A|B}，你不用担忧我，我再度成为天骄不过是早晚之事。

142024.en: I'm no longer a Heaven-chosen, {call|A|B}... What do I live for now...
142024.ch: 我不再是天骄了……{call|A|B}，你说我活着还有什么意义呢。

142025.en: How I wish I could go back to the old days when we were young, free and had nothing to fear. But now I'm a good-for-nothing without my Taoist Mind.
142025.ch: 真想回到过去，我们恣意洒脱、无所畏惧。可如今，我不过是个连道心都没有了的废人。

142026.en: {call|A|B}, I won't hide my feelings before you. My Taoist Mind was destroyed, and I'm now in the depths of despair.
142026.ch: {call|A|B},既然在你面前，那我就不强装平静了。我的道心被毁，如今简直悲痛欲绝。

142027.en: I'm not a Heaven-chosen anymore. Will you treat me the same way as before?
142027.ch: 我如今已不是天骄了，你还会待我如初吗？

142028.en: My Taoist Mind was destroyed, and I'm much weaker than before. I'm not in the mood to guide you anymore. If you can find a better Master, you can leave me as you wish.
142028.ch: 为师如今道心已毁，实力大不如前，也无心再教导你。你若寻到更好的师父，解除师徒关系也无妨。

142029.en: Thank you for your encouragement. I will get back to my feet and recover my Taoist Mind as soon as I can.
142029.ch: 多谢师父的鼓励，我会重振旗鼓，早日重塑道心的。

142030.en: My Taoist Mind is gone... My Taoist Mind is gone...
142030.ch: 我没有道心了……我没有道心了……

142031.en: My Taoist Mind is broken, and I would rather be dead than living such a pathetic life. Do you know it's all because of you?
142031.ch: 你可知我道心破碎，如今生不如死，全是拜你所赐。

142032.en: I was used to living as a Heaven-chosen, and it's because of you that my Taoist Mind was shattered. How shall I live from now on...
142032.ch: 我早已习惯了天骄的身份，可你害得我道心破碎，我日后可该如何活……

142033.en: Without the Taoist Mind, I'm a good-for-nothing now.
142033.ch: 失去了道心，我不过也就是一个废人了。

142034.en: I'm no longer a Heaven-chosen now. My family and friends will be so disappointed in me!
142034.ch: 我不再是天骄了，简直无颜面对亲友啊！

142035.en: What sort of woman do you like? Will you like someone like me?
142035.ch: 你喜欢什么样的女子，我这般的你可会喜欢？

142036.en: The outside world is vast. I really hope you can come with me to see it...
142036.ch: 外面的世界那么大，真希望你能陪我去看看……

142037.en: I like someone, but person is a blockhead who doesn't take the initiative. Am I, the woman, supposed to make the first move...?
142037.ch: 我喜欢着一个人，但那人就像个榆木脑袋不开窍，都不会主动一些，难不成让我一女子先开口……

142038.en: If you like someone you must tell her. Don't be a coward like me...
142038.ch: 如果你喜欢一个人，一定要告诉她，不要像我这般胆小……

142039.en: I've found that we have many similar preferences...
142039.ch: 我发现，我们很多喜好还挺相似的……

142040.en: {call|B|A}, I haven't seen you in days. I miss you...

142041.en: Being with you has brought a lot of happiness into my life...
142041.ch: 和你在一起后，我才感受到了诸多快乐……

142042.en: You are my destined half. The cold winds are warmer and the stars brighter after I've met you.
142042.ch: 你是我命中注定之人，遇到你之后，凛冬散尽，星河长明。

142043.en: I want to hold your hand and walk with to the ends of the Earth. I want to see the skies and the land with you, and taste the spray of the ocean and rock with you.
142043.ch: 想牵着你的手，一起到八荒的尽头，看天长地久的风景，尝海枯石烂的味道。

142044.en: From the first day I met you, your name has been carved into my heart.
142044.ch: 识你的第一天起，你的名字就刻在我的心底。

142045.en: I want to be by your side when we witness the beauty of the world, then tell you that all that beauty is less than a thousandth of yours.
142045.ch: 我想陪你看遍八荒美景，然后告诉你，它们都不及你万分之一。

142046.en: I would love to have a long, long future with you. I would love to get everyone's blessing to be with you. I would love to walk with you through your life's journey, lending each other warmth and support.
142046.ch: 很想和你拥有一个很长很长的未来，很想和你得到所有人的祝福，很想陪你走完你的一生，彼此温暖，互不辜负。

142047.en: As the years stretch on, I would like to travel with world with you just like this, no panic, no rush.
142047.ch: 岁月静好，很想和你就这样在八荒世界游历，不紧不慢，不慌不忙。

142048.en: The thought of spending the rest of my life with you fills me with delightful anticipation.
142048.ch: 一想到能和你共度余生，我就对余生充满了期待。

142049.en: May we always be of one heart and never part.
142049.ch: 愿得一人心，白首不相离。

142068.en: I actually fell in love with you the first day we met. Now, you are willing to join with me and become my Partner. I am very happy...
142068.ch: 其实，你我相遇的第一天，我便倾心于你，如今你愿与我结为道侣，我很欢喜……

142069.en: I don't know how many times I've dreamed about becoming your wife, and now it's finally coming true...
142069.ch: 不知多少次在梦里幻想着成为你的妻子，这一次，终于不是梦了……

142077.en: You are like the clouds in the sky. No one can match up to you.
142077.ch: 你就像那天上的云彩，无人可配你。

142078.en: I want to travel with you all over the world and see the myriad scenery.
142078.ch: 想带你走遍这八荒世界，看万千风景。

142079.en: The person I like is like a celestial living in the heavens. I am likely not worthy of her at all.
142079.ch: 我喜欢那人就如天上的仙子，我大概是配不上她吧。

142080.en: If you like someone you must tell him. Don't be a coward like me...
142080.ch: 如果你喜欢一个人，一定要告诉他，不要像我这般胆小……

142081.en: I looked at a mountain full of peach blossoms a few days ago and I thought of you.
142081.ch: 前几日我看着桃花满山，不知为何想起了你。

142110.en: I actually fell in love with you the first day we met. Now, you are willing to join with me and become my Partner. I am so happy...
142110.ch: 其实，你我相遇的第一天，我便倾心于你，如今你愿与我结为道侣，我很开心……

142111.en: I don't know how many times I've dreamed about becoming your husband, and now it's finally coming true...
142111.ch: 不知多少次在梦里幻想着成为你的丈夫，这一次，终于不是梦了……

142140.en: Once {school|A} has {call|B|A}, it will surely become the No.1 sect.
142140.ch: {school|A}能拥有{call|B|A}，必定会成为八荒第一宗门。

142142.en: {call|B|A}, every time the moon rises, I look at it and wonder if you are missing me too…
142142.ch: {call|B|A}，每当月光升起，我看着天上的月亮，就会想，你是否也在想我……

142143.en: {call|B|A}, I miss you. Even now when I see you, I still miss you…
142143.ch: {call|B|A}，我想你了，即使现在见到你还是很想你……

142144.en: {call|B|A}, do you also miss me when I miss you…
142144.ch: {call|B|A}，当我想你的时候，你会不会也刚好正在想我……

142145.en: {call|B|A}, you have no idea how much I missed you when I was away…
142145.ch: {call|B|A}，不能陪伴你的日子里，你知道我是多么的想你……

142146.en: {call|B|A}, I miss you all the time. Come and see me more often when you're free…
142146.ch: {call|B|A}，我无时无刻不在想你，你若有空便多来找找我……

142147.en: {call|B|A}, your eyes are like stars in my night sky, twinkling and flickering, like a distant song, an elusive flower…
142147.ch: {call|B|A}，你的眼睛是星星，总是在我的夜空里悬挂着，忽闪忽闪，像飘渺的歌声，依稀的花……

142172.en: {call|B|A}, I miss you. Even now when I see you, I still miss you
142172.ch: {call|B|A}，我想你了,即使现在见到你还是很想你

142173.en: {call|B|A}, do you also miss me when I miss you?
142173.ch: {call|B|A}，当我想你的时候,你会不会也刚好正在想我。

142177.en: I would love to be in the same sect as you, and I look forward to working with you…
142177.ch: 能和你在同一个宗门，我自是十分愿意的，以后，还请多多指教……

10000001.en: You and I have often had our differences, and now you wish to be my Sworn Son? Inconceivable!
10000001.ch: 你我之间素有嫌隙，可如今你竟想当我的义子，实在是莫名其妙。

10000002.en: I do not wish to take you in as my Sworn Daughter. Conduct yourself well.
10000002.ch: 我并不愿收你为义女，望你好自为之。

10000003.en: This is an important matter. Let me think about it.
10000003.ch: 此事非同小可，容我三思。

10000101.en: Your actions run contrary to my expectations for my Sworn Sons. Save your breath.
10000101.ch: 阁下行事与我收纳义子的原则相悖，在此多费口舌也只是徒劳。

10000102.en: Though your powers are formidable, I have a grievance against you. I must refuse.
10000102.ch: 虽然你道法高深，但既与我有怨，便由不得我不拒绝你。

10000201.en: Until the grievance between us is resolved, let us keep our distance.
10000201.ch: 宿怨尚未化解之前，你我还是保持距离为好。

10000202.en: To form a Sworn Bond is a good thing, but surely you know it cannot be.
10000202.ch: 想结义亲是个好事，可阁下也需有些眼色。

10000301.en: What I long for is a Sworn Older Brother who is like an actual brother to me. I'm afraid we are not close enough yet.
10000301.ch: 我更想要一个情同手足的义兄，但恐怕我们的关系暂时无法那么融洽。

10000302.en: The knot in my heart remains. I cannot accept this for now.
10000302.ch: 我的心结还未解开，暂时不能接受此事。

10000401.en: To be called Brother and Sister with the likes of you is truly quite hard to stomach!
10000401.ch: 与阁下以姐弟相称，可真是让人难以接受！

10000402.en: You want me to be your Sworn Older Sister? Hah! Perish the thought.
10000402.ch: 你还企图拜我为义姐？哼！莫不是想太多了吧。

10000501.en: You truly have no insight into how people feel. Why would I agree to be your Sworn Sister when I dislike you so?
10000501.ch: 你未免也太过不识人情，我这般讨厌你，怎会同你做兄妹？

10000502.en: I have never concealed my contempt for you. Have you not noticed?
10000502.ch: 在下对你的反感素未隐藏过，你难道从未察觉吗？

10000601.en: They say that a father and son of one mind can split gold. Our minds, however, cannot be farther apart.
10000601.ch: 都说父子同心，其利断金，可你我二人怕是难以同心。

10000602.en: I would be mad to want a rascal like you as a Father.
10000602.ch: 你这等卑劣之人，还想做我爹？难道是疯了不成？

10000701.en: My Adoptive Father must be one who towers betwixt heaven and earth. You seem to fall far short of the mark.
10000701.ch: 我的义父，定要是那种顶天立地之人，阁下还相差甚远呢。

10000702.en: You want to be my Sworn Mother? But earlier we... unless it was a mistake? Um... anyway, this would not be proper.
10000702.ch: 阁下想做我义母？可是先前我们…难道是误会？嗯…总之，这不太妥当。

10000801.en: Let us refrain from seeing one another, lest our annoyances fester and disrupt our focus.
10000801.ch: 你我最好还是不要见面，免得互生怨气，乱了心神。

10000901.en: How could you make such an unreasonable request? I see my dislike of you is well-founded!
10000901.ch: 阁下怎会提出如此无理之请？我对你的厌恶果然是有道理的！

10001001.en: Who would make Partners of their enemies? You jest!
10001001.ch: 何人会与仇敌结为道侣？阁下莫非是在说笑。

10001101.en: Only you can be ignorant of the fact that the greater Cultivator is the Master. What pretentiousness.
10001101.ch: 世人皆知，道行深者为师。阁下难道不知？可真是惺惺作态。

10001201.en: Have you forgotten your misdeeds? You could be a true immortal, and even that would never compel me to bow to the likes of you!
10001201.ch: 阁下难道忘记了曾经的所作所为？便是你境界再高深，也休想让我折腰！

10001301.en: I counsel you to look in a mirror before besmirching others.
10001301.ch: 在下奉劝你，污蔑他人前请先揽镜自照。

1000001.en: At last we meet! It is an honor to meet you.
1000001.ch: 久仰大名！今日一见，不甚荣幸。

1000002.en: They speak highly of you at {school|B}. Now that we meet, I am not disappointed!
1000002.ch: 先前在{school|B}便听闻道友大名，今日一见，果然名不虚传！

1000003.en: They speak highly of you at {school|B}. Your strength is the rock upon which {school|A} is built.
1000003.ch: 先前在{school|B}便听闻道友大名，以你的实力，定是{school|A}的中流砥柱。

1000004.en: It is a joy to know you.

1000005.en: The stories do not do you justice, my Lord!
1000005.ch: 百闻不如一见，阁下果然玉树临风。

1000006.en: Your name is known throughout the land!! What an honor it is to meet you today!
1000006.ch: 阁下之名，如雷贯耳！今日能当面请益，真是三生有幸。

1000007.en: I have always a hoped to meet you one day, and at long last, I receive my wish.
1000007.ch: 从前一直盼望能见你一面，时至今日，终于如愿。

1000008.en: As a huge admirer, I have longed to meet you for some time!

1000009.ch: 阁下名声响亮，今日一见，才知确是名副其实。

1000010.en: You have formidable knowledge, and it is to learn from you yourself that I have wanted to meet you for so long.
1000010.ch: 阁下对于道法极富心得，因此在下早想与您一见，好面聆教益。

1000011.en: I have met many people across the land, but very few who match your outstanding ability.
1000011.ch: 我在八荒之中见过不少人，似阁下一般的超凡脱俗的着实少见。

1000101.en: If things don't work out at {school|A}, you can always come over to {school|B}!
1000101.ch: 你若是在{school|A}混不下去了，便来投奔{school|B}吧！

1000102.en: If you are not happy at {school|A}, {school|B} will always be open to you.
1000102.ch: 若在{school|A}不顺心，可以考虑到{school|B}来，门为你一直开着。

1000103.ch: 即使你已加入{school|A}，我还是想将你招揽到{school|B}来。

1000104.en: Could I perhaps use our friendship to lure you out of {school|A} and into {school|B}?
1000104.ch: 以你我交情可以让你离开{school|A}加入到我{school|B}来么？

1001001.en: I was just thinking about you and you appeared!

1001002.en: I'm so glad I met you!

1001003.en: The Path of Cultivation isn't lonely at all with you by my side!
1001003.ch: 有你在身边，修道之路一点也不孤单了。

1001004.en: Let's train hard and travel the road to eternal life together.
1001004.ch: 我们定要努力修炼，一同踏上长生之道。

1001005.en: I don't want you to protect me all the time. I want to protect you too!
1001005.ch: 我不想一直被你保护着，我也想保护你。

1001006.en: I always feel safe when I'm with you.
1001006.ch: 有你在我身边，真的很有安全感。

1001007.en: I've been feeling down lately. Maybe I've been missing you...
1001007.ch: 最近心情有点低落，可能是我太想你了…

1001008.ch: 为何你的心情如此低落？若有心事，不妨与我说说。

1001009.en: {call|B|A}... do you miss me when I'm not around? Just a moment would be enough. That way we'll both be thinking of each other.

1001010.en: {call|B|A}, you are always on my mind.
1001010.ch: {call|B|A}，无论何时，你一直都在我心里。

1001011.en: I thought the world was boring... but then I met you.

1001012.en: I find your presence very soothing.

1001013.en: {call|B|A}, as long as you are with me, I shall fear no evil.

1001014.en: I will grow strong to protect you from all harm.
1001014.ch: 我会努力修炼变强，我绝不让任何人伤害你。

1001015.en: Though the world end, though love break my heart, I will always look upon thee with eyes of my youth.

1101570.ch: 虽说我早已经知晓{1}与我的{relation|X|B}有嫌隙，但我未想到{1}竟敢痛下杀手！此仇我岂能不报！

1101571.en: That thug {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! There's no way {gender|C} will get away with it.
1101571.ch: {1}这歹人竟然向我的{relation|X|B}暗下杀手！我是不会放过{gender|C}的。

1101572.en: My {relation|X|B} almost died! {1} is responsible. I will kill {gender2|C} and avenge my {relation|X|B}.
1101572.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}险些丧命，而凶手就是{1}。我一定要杀了{gender|C}替我的{relation|X|B}报仇。

1101573.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I'm too weak and cannot enact my vengeance.
1101573.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}！奈何我实力不足，无法寻仇。

1101574.en: My {relation|X} lies at death's door, all thanks to {1}! I'm going to kill {gender2|C}, one of these days!
1101574.ch: 我的{relation|X}如今仅剩一丝元魂，而这都是拜{1}所赐！总有一天，我除掉{gender|C}的。

1101575.en: {name|C} tried to kill my {relation|X|B}! I must have my vengeance! I will kill {gender2|C}, one of these days.
1101575.ch: {name|C}曾试图杀害我的{relation|X|B}！此仇我决不能忍，我一定要除掉{gender|C}。

1101576.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. I won't let {gender2|C} get away with it.
1101576.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被{1}杀害了，我是不会放过{gender|C}的。

1101577.en: That monster {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I have other business to attend to and cannot seek revenge.
1101577.ch: {1}真是手段狠辣，竟敢杀害我的{relation|X|B}！奈何为师近日还需处理一些作祟的妖兽，无法报仇。

1101578.en: That {1} has got a hide, attacking my {relation|X|B}! I will never let {gender2|C} get away with it.
1101578.ch: {1}实在胆大包天，居然敢来害我的{relation|X|B}！我定不会放过{gender|C}的。

1101579.en: That fiendish {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}! I'm going to kill that blight, one way or another!
1101579.ch: 这{1}向来作恶多端，但我未想到此人胆敢向我的{relation|X|B}下手！真想灭掉这祸害。

1101580.en: That {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}! I must have my vengeance!
1101580.ch: 这{1}竟向我的{relation|X|B}出手！这仇岂能不报！

1101581.en: Someone attacked my {relation|X|B}. Nobody died, but I still can't let it go.
1101581.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被人杀害了，虽说已被救活，但是这口气我咽不下去。

1101582.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}, that slimy, double-crossing... I can't seem to kill {gender2|C}, no matter how hard I try.
1101582.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}！但此人阴险狡诈，我几次想要击杀{gender|C}都失败了。

1101583.en: That brute {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I'm too weak and cannot avenge my {relation|X|B}.
1101583.ch: 这{1}真是欺人太甚，居然向我的{relation|X|B}下杀手！奈何我实力不足，不能替我的{relation|X|B}报仇。

1101584.en: I've been trying to avenge my {relation|X|B} for days now, but {1} is one slippery customer.
1101584.ch: 前些日我替我的{relation|X|B}寻仇，但却想不到{1}竟然如此难对付。

1101585.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. How can I not seek revenge?
1101585.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被{1}杀害，我岂能不报仇！

1101586.en: {1} attacked my {relation|X|B} and I cannot let it go!
1101586.ch: {1}竟敢对我的{relation|X|B}下手，我无论如何也不会放过此人的！

1101587.en: {1} tried to kill my {relation|X|B} and now is my enemy. {gender|C} will pay the price, I swear it.
1101587.ch: {1}竟企图杀害我的{relation|X|B}，那便是与我为敌，我势必要{gender|C}付出代价！

1101588.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. I cannot let {gender2|C} get away with it!
1101588.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}惨遭{1}杀害，我怎能放过{gender|C}！

1101589.en: Since {1} killed my {relation|X|B} all I can do is think about killing {gender2|C}.
1101589.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}，我定要与{gender|C}势不两立。

1101590.en: {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}. Completely unforgivable! One day I will kill {gender2|C}, once and for all.
1101590.ch: {1}竟然袭击我的{relation|X|B}，实在不可饶恕！总有一日，我要除掉{gender|C}。

1101591.en: {call|B|A}, {0} is my mortal enemy. The world isn't big enough for the both of us, but I am not accomplished enough to enact my vengeance.
1101591.ch: {call|B|A}，我与{0}仇深似海、不共戴天，可却始终无法将其手刃。

1101592.en: {call|B|A}, {1} is my mortal enemy. The world isn't big enough for the both of us, but I am not accomplished enough to enact my vengeance.
1101592.ch: {call|B|A}，我与{1}仇深似海、不共戴天，可却始终无法将其手刃。

1101600.en: Thank you for going to the trouble, {call|B|A}. I really appreciate it.
1101600.ch: {call|B|A}你愿为我费心，真叫我感激不尽。

1001902.en: You were gone so long. I missed you.

1001903.en: I always worry about you when you're not here. Then when you show up in one piece I breathe a sigh of relief.
1001903.ch: 你不在的日子，我总会想你过得好不好？会不会有人伤害你？如今见你一切安好，我便放心了。

1001904.en: To sup such divine soup, I can only wait for thee.
1001904.ch: 八荒珍材汇一汤，只待今日与君尝。

1001905.en: May your heart be like mine, so that our love will never die.
1001905.ch: 君心似我心，不负相思意。

1001906.en: When you're not here, not a second goes by that I'm not thinking about you.
1001906.ch: 你不在的日子，我无时无刻不在想你。

1001907.en: Your every gesture, your every word, haunts my dreams.
1001907.ch: 你的一颦一笑，你的一言一语都令我梦萦魂牵。

1001908.en: We gaze at each other, not growing tired, our thoughts combined from dawn to dusk.
1001908.ch: 相看两不厌，朝暮共神思。

1001909.en: No matter what happened before, you're the only one in my heart... Thinking about you, missing you.
1001909.ch: 不管以前如何，现在我的心里只有你…思你，念你。

1002001.en: Your face really bugs me. Stay out of my way.
1002001.ch: 你长得让我很不爽，下次别让我再看到你。

1002002.en: You remind me of that Mushroom Man I beat up last week.
1002002.ch: 上次我讨伐了一只药灵，长得跟你很像。

1002020.en: Your magnificent beauty reminds me of something. Oh, that's right! A Bambuki!
1002020.ch: 我一直觉得你很像个什么？对了，是竹妖！

1002021.en: Your greatness is such that I cannot help taking a step or two back upon seeing you in person.
1002021.ch: 阁下十分了得，我一看见你，就忍不住退开数尺。

1002022.en: I don't want to hear the sound of your voice. Get out.
1002022.ch: 我不想听见你的声音，请你离开。

1002023.en: I'm sick of the sight of you. Get out.
1002023.ch: 我不想看见你，请你离开。

1002024.en: I haven't the best impression of you. Have you really not noticed?
1002024.ch: 我对你观感不佳，难道你没看出来么？

1002025.en: Seeing you, I know for certain that my destiny over the next three months will not be good!
1002025.ch: 看见你，我就知道接下来三个月都会气运不佳！

1002003.en: Your {school|A} might be strong, but my {school|B} is pretty good too!
1002003.ch: 你所在的{school|A}虽强，但我{school|B}也不是吃素的！

1002004.en: You dare to offend me?! Not even {school|A} can protect you!
1002004.ch: 敢得罪我，即便是{school|A}也护不住你！

1002006.en: Those who value only appearance and not strength are destined to become the playthings of others.
1002006.ch: 空有相貌没有实力，怕是只能成为某些人的玩物

1010201.en: Excellent! From this day on, {name|C} shall be my Disciple!
1010201.ch: 好！从今日起，{name|C}便是我的弟子了！

1010301.en: I'm afraid {name|C} won't be a good Disciple for me. Please think it over, {call|B|A}.
1010301.ch: {name|C}恐怕不适合成为我的弟子，还望{call|B|A}三思。

1010401.en: {call|B|C} and I don't really see eye to eye. I don't want to become {gender1|C} Disciple. Please, {call|B|A}, think it over.
1010401.ch: {call|B|C}与我之间有些隔阂，我不愿意成为{gender|C}的弟子，还望{call|B|A}三思。

1010601.en: Since you invited me yourself, I'll gladly join {0}!
1010601.ch: 既是你亲自邀请，那么我便加入{0}吧！

1010602.en: Thinking about it, being in the same sect sounds like a good idea. I'll do it.
1010602.ch: 若是与你在同一宗门，想想倒也挺美好的，那我就应了此事。

1010603.en: As it happens, I don't have a sect either. If we're in the same sect, we'll be able to keep an eye on each other just as well.
1010603.ch: 正好我如今也无宗门，我们夫妻俩在同宗门也好互相有个照应。

1010611.en: My current sect is pretty good, but if I can be in the same sect as you, of course that would be even better.
1010611.ch: 虽说我如今的宗门倒也不错，但若能与你在同宗门自然更好。

1010612.en: Since it is you who is asking, {call|B|A}, how could I possibly refuse?
1010612.ch: 既然{call|B|A}想邀我与你在同一宗门，那我自然不会拒绝。

1010701.en: Sorry, I don't want to join {0}.

1010702.en: I'm not ready to join a sect.

1010711.en: Everyone is different. {0} isn't really what I want. I hope you can understand.
1010711.ch: 人各有志，{0}并非我心所愿，还望阁下理解。

1010712.en: In my experience, Rogue Cultivators don't have it that easy.
1010712.ch: 以我的资质，做个散修岂不是更逍遥快活。

1010721.en: I'm used to where I am. Changing sects again will be too much trouble.
1010721.ch: 我早已适应了如今所在的宗门，再做更换实在繁琐。

1010722.en: I'd like to see more of you too, but I am happy with my current situation.
1010722.ch: 虽说我也想与你日日相见，但我如今所在的宗门的确更为合适。

1010723.en: Since we're already married, I'll be straight with you. I don't want to join {0}.
1010723.ch: 既然你我已是夫妻，那我便直言了，我并不愿加入{0}。

1010731.en: I think we already see enough of each other. I'm afraid I can't accept.
1010731.ch: 我并不愿与你有过多接触，恕我不能应你此事。

1010732.en: The sect would be so nasty with you there. There's no way I'm joining.
1010732.ch: 有你在的宗门，想必污浊不堪，我可不愿加入。

1010801.en: I'd love to teach you the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> today. Do you want to learn it?
1010801.ch: 今日我欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>之道传授于你，你可愿接受？

1010901.en: Since you want to impart seeds of the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> to me, I don't see how I can refuse you, {call|B|A}. Henceforth I will put the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> to good use.
1010901.ch: 既然你愿将<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>所凝之种传授于我，我绝不会辜负{call|B|A}你的期望，今后定会努力贯彻<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>之道。

1011001.en: How kind of you, {call|B|A}... But this <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> is not the path that I am looking for. Please accept my apologies.
1011001.ch: 多谢{call|B|A}美意…只是这<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>并非我所追求之道，恕我拒绝。

1011201.en: I'd love to teach you the <r>{taoistHeart|B}</r> today. Do you want to learn it?
1011201.ch: 今日我欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>之道传授于你，你可愿接受？

8000001.en: You associate with our Taoist Mind Pavilion members so often. No wonder you found out my identity.
8000001.ch: 你常常与我道心阁之人有所往来，难怪能发现我的身份。

8000002.en: You're a meticulous one to find I belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
8000002.ch: 阁下倒是心思缜密，竟发现了我乃道心阁之人。

8000003.en: That's right. I belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
8000003.ch: 不错，在下正是道心阁之人。

8000004.en: You are close to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and now you have found my identity. Maybe we are meant to be acquainted.
8000004.ch: 你与道心阁关系如此亲近，这下又发现了我的身份，倒是有缘。

8000005.en: I've always been keeping a low profile, and I never thought you could find out my identity.
8000005.ch: 我向来低调行事，想不到竟然被你发现了我的身份。

8000006.en: Yes, you found my identity, so what?
8000006.ch: 不过是发现了我的身份罢了，有何好嚣张的！

8000007.en: I do belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and you are close to them yourself, but I don't want to get involved with you. Good bye!
8000007.ch: 虽说我的确是道心阁之人，你又与道心阁十分交好，但我并不想与你过多交谈，告辞。

8000008.en: You may have found my identity, and you are close to our Taoist Mind Pavilion yourself, but I'm too busy at the moment to talk with you. Excuse me.
8000008.ch: 虽说阁下发现了我的身份，还与我道心阁交好。但在下还有要事缠身，先行告辞。

8000009.en: There's really no secret from you, {call|A|B}.

8000010.en: So you discovered my identity as a Taoist Mind Pavilion member. That's so you, my partner.
8000010.ch: 不愧是我的道侣，果然心细，我这道心阁之人的身份都被你给发现了。

8000011.en: Well, now that you have found my identity, I don't need to hide anything from you anymore.
8000011.ch: 如此也好，既然你发现了我的身份，我们日后也算可以坦诚相见了。

8000012.en: Now that you have found my identity, there's something I need to remind you. To be on close terms with the Taoist Mind Pavilion may bring you benefits, but you should always be aware of the risk.
8000012.ch: 既然你知道了我的身份，那{relation|B|A}也在此劝诫你一句，与道心阁交好虽益处颇多，但免不了有危险，你且谨慎些。

8000013.en: {relation|A|B}, I do belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, but there's nothing for you to worry about. I will respect you and treat you well just as I used to.
8000013.ch: {relation|A|B}，我确实是道心阁之人。但您且放心，无论以后发生什么，我都会一如既往的孝敬您。

8000014.en: {relation|A|B}, so you know I belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion now.
8000014.ch: {relation|A|B}，看来你已经知道我是道心阁之人了。

8000015.en: Though you are my favorite pupil, my identity is a very confidential matter, so I didn't tell you before.
8000015.ch: 虽说你是为师的爱徒，但为师的身份不可轻易外传，因此一直未告诉你此事。

8000016.en: Well, I suppose there's nothing I can hide from you, Master.
8000016.ch: 果然还是什么都瞒不过您啊，师父。

8000017.en: {call|A|B}, while I am the {post|B} in our {school|A}, I'm also a member of the Taoist Mind Pavilion at the same time.
8000017.ch: {call|A|B}，虽然我是我们{school|A}的{post|B}，但我的确还有道心阁之人这一身份。

8000018.en: Now you know who I am, hahaha! You'd better watch your behavior and stop being so cocky all day long.
8000018.ch: 现在知道我的身份了吧，哈哈哈！既然如此，那就奉劝你一句，别整日一副嚣张跋扈的模样。

8000019.en: I saw you associate with Taoist Mind Pavilion members quite often, and you must know something about them. Now that you have learned about my identity, you should be more respectful to me.
8000019.ch: 我见你常常与道心阁之人有所往来，想必对其了解不少吧。如今发现了我的身份，还不快放尊敬些。

8000103.en: That's right. I do belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion. You may be close to the Mindsnap Temple, but that shouldn't stop us from being friends.
8000103.ch: 不错，在下正是道心阁之人。虽说你与蚀心殿之人十分亲近，但这并不妨碍你我往来。

8000104.en: You and I have never met before, yet you have found out my identity. Maybe we are meant to be acquainted.
8000104.ch: 你我素未相识，你就已然发现了我的身份，倒也是种缘分。

8000105.en: Now that you know I'm a Taoist Mind Pavilion member, we have nothing more to say to each other. Farewell.
8000105.ch: 你既已知我乃道心阁之人，那就不必多说了，告辞。

8000106.en: You often associate with Mindsnap Temple members, and now that you have found out I belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, I don't have anything more to say to you. Farewell.
8000106.ch: 你常与蚀心殿之人往来，既然发现我乃道心阁之人，那就不必与你过多解释了，告辞。

8000107.en: Maybe I should have brought it out to you in the first place, but my Taoist Mind Pavilion identity is a confidential matter. That's why I never told you. Please do forgive me.
8000107.ch: 其实此事我早该告知于你，奈何我道心阁的身份需要保密，也就隐瞒至了今日，还望{call|B|A}不要埋怨我。

8000109.en: Well, now that you have found out my identity, I don't need to hide anything from you anymore.
8000109.ch: 如此也好，既然你发现了我的身份，我们日后便可坦诚相见了。

8000110.en: Joining Taoist Mind Pavilion may have brought me some benefits, but I was also involved in many troubles. I hid it from you to avoid getting you involved too.
8000110.ch: 虽说加入道心阁益处颇多，但免不了有纠纷。因而我一直隐瞒着此事，不希望你卷入危机之中。

8000117.en: Well, now that you know I belong to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, you still dare appear before me? You may know some friends in the Mindsnap Temple, but I don't fear you at all.
8000117.ch: 哟，都知道我是道心阁之人了，还敢出现在我面前？你不过是与蚀心殿之人有些往来罢了，我可不惧你。

8000201.ch: 你常常与我蚀心殿之人有所往来，难怪能发现我的身份。

8201201.en: I have some important matters to tend to, so I shall have to leave early.
8201201.ch: 在下还有要事，先行告辞。

8201202.en: Forgive me if I am being presumptuous, but you should groom yourself before we go out to make friends.
8201202.ch: 恕我冒昧，前辈且先梳理好仪容，再外出交友吧。

8201203.en: Your appearance is different from normal people, and I become timid when I look at you. I have some important things to do, so goodbye.
8201203.ch: 我观阁下容貌，似与常人不同，让我不禁心生胆怯。在下还有要事，告辞。

8201204.en: Senior and I are not on the same Taoist paths, so why is there a need for us to talk?

8201301.en: You are the Sect Leader of {school|A}, so it is best for you to pay attention to your appearance.
8201301.ch: 阁下贵为{school|A}宗主，还是注意些仪容些好。

8201302.en: Excuse me, Sect Leader, but your appearance is frightful and might damage the Prestige of the Sect.
8201302.ch: 恕在下冒犯，宗主此番容貌外出恐有损我宗名誉。

8201401.en: You have targeted me many times before, Mentor. How are you planning on humiliating me this time after appearing in front of me?!
8201401.ch: 前辈先前多番针对我，这次出现在我面前又想如何羞辱我！

8201402.en: Fellows of the same Tao should care for each other. However, your actions are too much, Mentor.
